insight: The invite-only Sora app hit No. 1 on the US App Store within 48 hours of its October 2025 launch.
name: Sora
tagline: OpenAI's video generator as a standalone app.
description: OpenAI's video model surfaced as a consumer product — generate, remix, and share short videos from prompts or images. Available standalone and bundled into ChatGPT for subscribers.

changelog.summary: Archived — OpenAI discontinued the Sora web and app on 2026-04-26 (API sunsets 2026-09-24) after heavy losses; the standalone consumer app is shut down.

edge: Shipped as a TikTok-style social app with a feed, remixing, and cameos — consumer-first, unlike the API-first video tools around it.
cons: No open API parity with rivals

references.title: Sora 2: Examples, Critiques, and Early Impressions
